info.title: Utilities
info.description:
The utility APIs are endpoints that contains supporting resources you will need in building your Online Travel Application. Some of these endpoints are:

1. Airlines
2. Airport Search

> Before you proceed, we recommend you read our [Authentication documentation](https://docs.tiqwa.com/docs/tiqwa/reference/Authentication.v1.json) to understand how to get authenticated and generate access tokens.

> Sandbox Base URL: https://sandbox.tiqwa.com/v1/

> Production Base URL: https://prod.tiqwa.com/v1/

get.description:
This endpoint returns a list of Airports based on the search keyword parameter provided. The endpoint should be used as an auto-suggestion on the [Flight Search Offer](https://docs.tiqwa.com/docs/tiqwa/reference/Flight.v1.json/paths/~1search/get) origin and destination fields.

> Airport IATA Code, City, Airport Name and Country are also matched using the keyword provided

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Query keyword to search for (E.g LOS, Lagos, Nigeria, Abuja, Newyork...) You can also send a list of airport code seperated by comma to return the airport details for those codes e.g (LOS,ABV,LHR)

get.description: This endpoint returns all the available Airlines.

This endpoint returns the wallet balance of the authenticated company.

> API balance is used for making API calls, while Ticket balance for issuing/paying for tickets. API units on the other hand is for customers that purchased API units instead of the pay-as-you-use

post.description:
This endpoint adds a new markup settings to your list of markups.

> Once a markup is created it is automatically activated and synced.

Example 1.name: EThopia Test Markup
Example 1.remark: This markup should be considered as base markup

applicable_rule.description: These are the rules to apply to the markup.

exclusion_rule.description: These are the rules used in excluding a particular flight search result from being applied to the markup

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The reference ID of the markup to be updated
